title.en: An Act Making An Addition to Section One of Act Numbered Eighteen Hundred and thirty-Nine, Providing that the third Members of Provincial Boards, Created By Act Numbered Fifteen Hundred and Forty-Five, Shall Be Reimbursed their Actual and Necessary Traveling Expenses When Attending the Sessions of the Provincial Board, If Such Members Reside At a Place Other than the Seat of the Provincial Government.

text.en:
The following proviso is hereby added to section one of Act Numbered Eighteen hundred and
thirty-nine, at the end thereof:
"Provided, further, That the third members of provincial boards created by Act Numbered Fifteen hundred and
forty-five, as amended, shall be entitled to receive from the respective provincial treasuries the reimbursement
of their actual and necessary traveling expenses, from their place of residence to the place where the
provincial board holds its sessions, when going to the said sessions :ind returning from the same."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 20, 1909.
